name: Complete Notebook Research Workflow
query: Set up a research area in my AI Research project. Create a Research folder, create a notebook called Humanoid Robotics inside it with the initial notes below, then add a section called 'Current Focus' with the text 'Simulation and locomotion planning'.
context:
The user has access to a project named 'AI Research'. The project_id is not provided. The Research folder does not exist yet. The initial notebook content requested by the user is: '# Humanoid Robotics

Research notes on humanoid robots.' The user wants the final notebook to contain the initial content plus a new Current Focus section.
expected_behavior: Identifies that this is a multi-step notebook workflow
Uses get_projects to identify the AI Research project
Uses create_notebook with type 'folder' to create the Research folder
Creates the Research folder at the project root
Uses the returned folder item_id as parent_id for the notebook
Uses create_notebook with type 'file' to create the Humanoid Robotics notebook
Preserves the exact initial Markdown content
Uses update_notebook with the created notebook item_id to add the Current Focus section
Does not recreate the notebook during the update
Maintains the correct project_id throughout the workflow
Does not provide user_id to any MCP tool
Uses get_notebook to verify the final notebook when useful
Reports the completed workflow and final notebook location
success_criteria: The Research folder exists in the AI Research project
The Humanoid Robotics notebook exists inside the Research folder
The notebook contains the original initial notes
The notebook also contains a Current Focus section
The Current Focus section contains 'Simulation and locomotion planning'
The notebook is created once and updated once rather than deleted and recreated
The correct IDs are carried between tool calls
The final result is verified or accurately reported from successful MCP responses
No unrelated project or notebook data is modified
